title: TourGuide Professions
wikitext: '''TourGuide Professions''' is a profession leveling guide. It is designed to help players efficiently level their in-game professions—such as Tailoring, Leatherworking, Engineering, Enchanting, Cooking, and Blacksmithing—by providing step-by-step instructions. == Installation == '''GitAddonsManager''' The easiest way to keep '''TourGuide Professions''' up to date is by using [[GitAddonsManager]]. # '''Add the Repository:''' Add the following URL to GitAddonsManager: https://github.com/cralor/TourGuide_Professions.git # '''Select the Branch:''' Ensure that the master branch is selected. # '''Update:''' Using GitAddonsManager, you can check for and install updates for all your AddOns with a single click. '''Manual Installation''' If you prefer manual installation, follow these steps: # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Unpack the .zip and rename the folder to TourGuide_Professions, removing the -master suffix. # Move the folder into your Interface/AddOns directory and restart the game. '''Important:''' This addon requires [[TourGuide Turtle|TourGuide]] to work. == Git Links == * [https://github.com/cralor/TourGuide_Professions '''(cralor)'''] == Usage == * The guide list window can be toggled by right-clicking on the TourGuide then click the Guides button. * Follow the instructions provided in each step for efficient leveling. * The guide includes quest turn-ins, vendor purchases, and crafting recipes. == Preview == TourGuide: [[File:TG.png|border|frameless|199x199px]] Guide: [[File:TGP.png|border|frameless|480x480px]] == Tailoring 1-300 == '''Materials Needed (approximate):''' 160x Linen Cloth, 200x Wool Cloth, 760x Silk Cloth, 520x Mageweave Cloth, 900x Runecloth, 120x Rugged Leather, Coarse Thread, Fine Thread, Dyes, Silken Thread, Heavy Silken Thread, Rune Thread '''Key Steps:''' * 1-50: Linen Cloth, Linen Bags, Reinforced Linen Cape * 75-105: Woolen Cloth, Woolen Shirts, Shoulders * 125-160: Silk Cloth, Silk Hood, Headband, White Shirt * 185-200: Mageweave Cloth, Silk Vest, Pantaloons * 215-250: Mageweave, Black Mageweave Leggings, Gloves, Headband/Shoulders * 260-300: Runecloth, Runecloth Belt, Runecloth Gloves == Leatherworking 1-300 == '''Materials Needed (approximate):''' 275x Light Leather, Medium Heavy Leather, Heavy Leather, Rugged Leather, Thick Leather, Turtle Scale, Wildvine, Leather Belts, Boots, Bracers '''Key Steps:''' * 1-150: Light Leather, Cured Leather, Embossed Leather, Dark Leather, Heavy Leather, Leather Belts, Shoulders, Legs * 150-250: Thick Leather, Rugged Leather, Nightscape Headband/Tunic, Pants * 250-300: Wicked Leather, Leather Headband, Bracers, Boots == Engineering 1-300 == '''Materials Needed (approximate):''' 90x Rough Stone, Copper, Silver, Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Thorium, Dense Stone, Worn Dragonscale, Scorpid Scale '''Key Items & Recipes:''' * Basic: Blasting Powder, Copper Tubes, Bronze Tubes, Small/Bombs, Mithril Tubes, Triggers, Casings, Gyro-Shots, Thorium Shells * Advanced: Core of Earth, Heart of Fire, Breath of Wind, Thorium Bars, Thorium Plans (visit Gadgetzan for plans) == Enchanting 1-300 == '''Materials Needed (approximate):''' 150x Strange Dust, 90x Soul Dust, 170x Vision Dust, 300x Dream Dust, Illusion Dust, Various Rods, Greater Eternal, Pearls, Gems '''Key Steps:''' * 1-75: Runed Copper Rod, Minor Enchantments * 75-150: Enchant Bracers, Shields, Circlets * 150-250: Greater Enchantments, Cloaks, Gloves, Chests * 250-300: Higher-level enchants, buy Lesser Mana Oil from vendors in Silithus, etc. == Cooking 1-300 == '''Materials Needed (approximate):''' Various meats, spices, herbs, and special ingredients from different zones. '''For Horde:''' * 1-40: Spice Bread, Bear Meat, Smoked Bear Meat * 90-125: Dig Rats, Dig Rat Stew, Raptor Flesh, Roast Raptor * 200-250: Spider Meat, Spider Sausage, Zesty Clam Meat, Tender Wolf Steaks, Monster Omelet * 285-300: Sandworm Meat, Smoked Desert Dumplings (kill Dredge Crushers/Strikers in Silithus) '''For Alliance:''' * 1-40: Spice Bread, Bear Meat, Smoked Bear Meat * 75-85: Crawler Meat, Crab Cake * 85-130: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs, Stormwind Herbs * 130-175: Raptor Eggs, Curiously Tasty Omelet, Roast Raptor * 200-250: Spider Meat, Spider Sausage, Zesty Clam Meat, Tender Wolf Steaks * 285-300: Sandworm Meat, Smoked Desert Dumplings == Blacksmithing 1-300 == '''Materials Needed (approximate):''' 90x Rough Stone, Copper, Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Thorium, Dense Stone, Cores of Earth, Mageweave, Rugged Leather '''Key Items & Recipes:''' * Basic: Sharpening Stones, Grinding Stones, Copper & Bronze Gear * Advanced: Iron & Steel Plate, Mithril Coif, Earthforged & Emberforged gear, Thorium plans (visit Gadgetzan for Imperial Plate plans) == Usage Tips: == * Follow each step for efficient farming and crafting. * Purchase recipes from vendors when available. * Kill specific mobs to gather materials. * Use the guide as a checklist for materials and steps. * Transition between zones using the "F" lines to optimize leveling.
